card.name: Verbs and links before a scope or range
card.fires_on: Short linking or verb words right where a sentence is about to widen into a list, scope or quantity, such as 'including' after a comma, 'has' before 'evolved to encompass', or 'away' after 'throw'.

modes.label: Including after a comma
modes.description: The word 'including' after a comma, introducing a part of a broader set, as in analgesic requirement wording.
modes.example: during periods of changing analgesic requirements,<< including>> initial titration.

modes.label: Verb leading to a broad statement
modes.description: A verb or particle in a general statement about scale or spread.
modes.example: Environment Canada says we throw<< away>> 4 million disposable diapers a day!

modes.label: Comma before a plural claim
modes.description: A comma after a singular thing, before a claim that there are many kinds.
modes.example: as if it were a single thing<<,>> there are actually numerous diferent infin

card.writes: It seems to lower the odds of words meaning 'everywhere' or 'all kinds', so the text moves toward specific items.
card.plain: It fires on small words that open up a list or a wide statement, such as 'including'.
